g.text: NEXUS OF ETERNITY · WRDL GREEN STRATEGY
Fixate always gets a green. Melee stand closest to bait the other two; ranged and healers stay farther back. Three players per green; stay in one circle only.
Player
Green player
Fixate
Green
P1 · Staff
Vloxx
Melee
Ranged
Healers
Placement
Fixate always gets a green. Both healers
join that player; if a healer is fixated,
the floater joins them to make three.
Melee stand closest to Vloxx to get the other
two greens. Ranged players stay farther away.
If two melee players get greens, both start
moving right. The player in front goes to
ranged; the other stays with melee.
A ranged player who gets a green stays with
ranged. If melee has only two people, a
ranged player without a green moves to melee.
P2 · Spear
Vloxx
Melee
Healers
Ranged
Placement
Keep all three greens between the red
lines: melee at the front, healers
back left and ranged back right.
Both healers join fixate. If a
healer is fixated, the floater joins
them so that green has three people.
If two melee players get greens, both head back
right. The player in front goes to ranged; the
other stays at the front with melee.
A ranged player who gets a green stays back
right. If melee has only two people, a ranged
player without a green moves to the front.
P3 · Sword
Vloxx
Healers
Melee
Ranged
Placement
Fixate stands inside Vloxx’s hitbox, just in
front of his centre. Both healers stand just
behind his centre, inside fixate’s green.
The players with the other two greens move behind
Vloxx, to the left and right. Move far enough
back that neither circle overlaps fixate’s green.
Everyone else joins their assigned green.
Stand toward the middle of the formation
while staying inside only your own circle.
P4 · Bunker
CM ONLY
Vloxx
Melee
Healers
Ranged
Projectile Block
Placement
Use this formation in CM only. In
LCM, P4 Spears cannot be blocked; use
the Boneskinner formation instead.
Place melee directly behind Vloxx, with healers
left and ranged right. Overlap all three greens
inside the purple projectile-block circle.
Stand with your assigned group, inside
your own green and outside any overlap
with another green. Keep projectile blocks
active to protect everyone from Spears.
P4 · Boneskinner
CM / LCM
Vloxx
Melee
Healers
Ranged
Move left
together
Placement
Line up behind Vloxx: melee nearest him,
healers in the middle and ranged at the back.
Keep at least three people in each green.
Move left together to leave the Spear circles and
third-wave Puddles behind. Move with the players
in your green so everyone remains inside it.
